_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "settings_json" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "legal_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "state_code" TEXT NULL, "dealer_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'regular', "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "address" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone_number" TEXT NULL, "logo_url" TEXT NULL, "signature_url" TEXT NULL, "signatory_name" TEXT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "bank_account_number" TEXT NULL, "bank_ifsc" TEXT NULL, "upi_id" TEXT NULL, "is_cloud_sync_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_cloud_sync_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_dropbox_sync_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_dropbox_sync_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ledger', "enabled_modules_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_name" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "business_type" TEXT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "bank_account_number" TEXT NULL, "bank_ifsc" TEXT NULL, "upi_id" TEXT NULL, "active_company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin', "companies_json" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_memberships" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "joined_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "push_token" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key", "profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parties" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default' REFERENCES companies (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "net_balance_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_updated" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default' REFERENCES companies (id), "party_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parties (id), "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "receipt_photo_url" TEXT NULL, "is_voided" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_voided" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "old_state_json" TEXT NULL, "new_state_json" TEXT NULL, "diff_json" TEXT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_checksum" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mutation_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("table_name", "record_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("table_name", "company_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "sku" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PCS', "purchase_price_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "selling_price_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "current_stock_quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "minimum_stock_alert" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.0, "hsn_code" TEXT NULL, "tax_rate_percent" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items (id), "voucher_id" TEXT NULL, "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_cost_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_cost_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "running_stock_quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "parent_account_id" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "description" TEXT NULL, "current_balance_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vouchers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "voucher_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "party_id" TEXT NULL, "party_name" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'posted', "payment_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "subtotal_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "narration" TEXT NULL, "reference_number" TEXT NULL, "source_voucher_id" TEXT NULL, "receipt_photo_url" TEXT NULL, "items_json" TEXT NULL, "category_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "wallet_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_wallet_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "journal_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "voucher_id" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "narration" TEXT NULL, "total_amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'posted', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "journal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES journals (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "party_id" TEXT NULL, "debit_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "credit_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "narration" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "category_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rollover_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rollover_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cmp_default', "template_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "next_run_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_wallets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "wallet_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "starting_balance_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "current_balance_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color_hex" TEXT NULL, "icon_name" TEXT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "parent_category_id" TEXT NULL, "icon_name" TEXT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_wallets (id), "to_wallet_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES expense_wallets (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES expense_categories (id), "transaction_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "payee_or_payer" TEXT NULL, "reference_number" TEXT NULL, "receipt_photo_url" TEXT NULL, "is_cleared" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_cleared" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES expense_categories (id), "period_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "amount_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "alert_threshold_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "template_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "next_run_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remote_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_transactions (id), "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_type" TEXT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
